digest.component_or_area: MCP model schema generation and validation
propositions: BridgeFsckOut in _mcp_models.py declares three properties but bridge_fsck.schema.json requires four, missing binding_drift field that _engine_support/bridge_fsck.py emits unconditionally
VerifySignatureResultOut marks algorithm, head_sha, and key_id as optional but the schema requires all three fields
_mcp_models.py hand-mirrors five JSON schemas with no generator or drift gate, unlike the TypedDict layer which uses schemas/gen_types.py with CI enforcement
False assurance comment in _mcp_models.py:31-34 claims cross-interface schema tests pin MCP models to canonical schemas but no such tests exist for BridgeFsckOut, GroundingInfoOut, or WorkflowRunOut
MCP model layer needs generation from schemas or equivalent --check drift gate to enforce currency like the TypedDict layer
